levels.surface: مقسما، مولى عبد الله بن الحارث

notes: «سمع مقسما ... يحدث عن ابن عباس» is rule 5: Miqsam is named as the source Abd al-Karim heard, and Ibn Abbas is the source Miqsam relays
Ibn Abbas is the Companion whose exegesis of the verse is the saying, so he is the last link
«ويقال هو مولى عبد الله بن عباس» and the closing «قال أبو عيسى» are Tirmidhi's own glosses, left out; «ابن عباس» occurrence 1 is the chain's, the other is in that gloss
